column3: “Every one of you” renders “a man,” and “reverence” renders “fear.”
“at all” renders an emphatic doubled verb, and “an offense” renders “piggul,” refuse meat.
“to the very corners of your field” renders “you shall not finish the corner (pe’ah) of your field.”
“to one another” renders “a man to his fellow.”
“be partial to the poor” renders “lift up the face of the poor,” “defer to the great” renders “honor the face of the great,” and “fairly” renders “in righteousness.”
“act against the life of” renders “stand against the blood of.”
“your fellow countryman” renders “your brother,” and “surely” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
“breed together” renders “make lie together,” and “two kinds of material mixed together” renders “two kinds, sha’atnez.”
“in no way” renders an emphatic doubled verb; “punishment” renders a rare word (biqqoret) whose meaning is uncertain.
“count their fruit as forbidden” renders “treat its fruit as its foreskin,” and “forbidden” renders “uncircumcised.”
“for the dead” renders “for a soul (nefesh),” and “tattoo marks” renders “an inscription of incision.”
“fall to harlotry” renders “play the harlot,” and “lewdness” renders “zimmah,” wickedness.
